description: Scan each unit's plan for policy violations with Checkov

flags.help: Checkov version to install and run.
flags.name: cli-version

flags.help: Check ids that deny the change, as in CKV_AWS_23. Globs allowed, as in CKV_AWS_*. Every id is listed in the Checkov policy index at https://www.checkov.io/5.Policy%20Index/all.html, and each finding this hook reports names the id it failed.
flags.name: deny-checks

flags.help: Check ids that warn about the change, as in CKV_AWS_23. Globs allowed, as in CKV_AWS_*. Every id is listed in the Checkov policy index at https://www.checkov.io/5.Policy%20Index/all.html, and each finding this hook reports names the id it failed.
flags.name: warn-checks

flags.help: Log verbosity. A more verbose PIPELINES_LOG_LEVEL overrides it. One of: trace,debug,info,warning,error,fatal,panic.
flags.name: log-level

name: checkov
title: Checkov
